description: Flat metadata schema for one individual-level record in a human cohort sequencing study focused on disease susceptibility, demographic diversity, biospecimen handling, consent, and sequencing context.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or participant sample entry within the study (e.g., internal code or UUID).

participant_id.descr: Unique de-identified participant identifier; must not contain direct personal identifiers.

sample_id.descr: Unique biospecimen or DNA sample identifier linked to this participant.

collection_date.descr: Date when the biospecimen or participant data were collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

birth_year.descr: Participant year of birth, if permitted by consent and ethics approval.

age_at_collection.descr: Participant age in years at the time of sample collection.

sex_at_birth.descr: Reported sex assigned at birth; expected values such as female, male, intersex, unknown.

gender_identity.descr: Self-reported gender identity, if collected; free-text or controlled term.

self_reported_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported ethnicity or ethnic affiliation, using study-defined controlled categories where possible.

self_reported_ancestry.descr: Self-reported ancestry or population background, including mixed ancestry if applicable.

country_of_birth.descr: Country where the participant was born, if collected.

country_of_residence.descr: Country of current residence at the time of collection, if collected.

population_group.descr: Study-defined population group or cohort label used for stratification in analysis.

language_of_consent.descr: Language in which consent materials were provided or consent was obtained.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained for this participant/sample.

consent_type.descr: Type of consent provided, such as broad research consent, tiered consent, disease-specific consent, or no data sharing.

consent_scope_genomic.descr: Whether consent permits genomic sequencing and analysis.

consent_scope_data_sharing.descr: Whether consent permits controlled or open sharing of de-identified genomic data.

consent_scope_recontact.descr: Whether the participant consented to future recontact or return of results.

consent_withdrawn.descr: Whether consent was later withdrawn by the participant.

ethics_approval_id.descr: Institutional review board or ethics committee approval identifier.

consent_leaflet_version.descr: Version or revision identifier of the participant information leaflet/consent form used.

consent_method.descr: Mode of consent acquisition, such as written, electronic, verbal-witnessed, or proxy.

disease_status.descr: Overall disease status relevant to the study, such as case, control, unaffected, or unknown.

primary_disease_phenotype.descr: Primary disease or phenotype studied for this participant, using a standardized disease term when possible.

phenotype_definition_version.descr: Version or reference of the case/control or phenotype ascertainment definition used.

diagnosis_date.descr: Date of first diagnosis for the primary disease phenotype, if applicable.

family_history_disease.descr: Whether there is a reported family history of the disease or related phenotype.

family_history_details.descr: Free-text summary of family history, including affected relatives and relationship if available.

comorbidities.descr: Other relevant diagnoses or comorbid conditions reported for the participant.

medication_status.descr: Current or relevant medication status that may influence phenotype interpretation.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at or near collection time, if collected; e.g., never, former, current, unknown.

bmi.descr: Body mass index at collection time in kg/m^2, if measured.

blood_pressure_systolic.descr: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg, if measured.

blood_pressure_diastolic.descr: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg, if measured.

sample_source.descr: Biospecimen source material; for this study typically saliva, but may include blood or other source if applicable.

sample_collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the biospecimen, such as saliva kit, passive drool, or swab.

sample_storage_temperature.descr: Storage temperature of the sample or extracted DNA, in degrees Celsius.

dna_extracted.descr: Whether DNA was successfully extracted from the biospecimen.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol, kit name, or method used.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield obtained from extraction, in nanograms (ng).

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration, in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL).

dna_integrity_value.descr: DNA integrity or quality metric reported by the laboratory, such as DIN or similar assay value.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol, kit, or method used before sequencing.

target_capture_method.descr: Target enrichment or capture approach used, if any; otherwise indicate none.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq or equivalent.

sequencing_center.descr: Laboratory or center that performed sequencing.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used, such as WGS, WES, or targeted panel.

read_layout.descr: Read configuration, such as single-end, paired-end, or mate-pair.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp).

mean_coverage_depth.descr: Average sequencing depth across the target region or genome, in X-fold coverage.

coverage_uniformity_pct.descr: Percent of target bases covered at or above the study threshold, if applicable.

gc_bias_metric.descr: Sequencing GC bias metric or comparable run-level quality indicator.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the variant-calling pipeline used to generate genetic variants.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and variant calling, such as GRCh37 or GRCh38.

variant_annotation_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the variant annotation pipeline or annotation database release.

common_variant_analysis_only.descr: Whether the record is restricted to common variant analysis rather than rare variant analysis.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample and sequencing data passed the study's quality-control criteria.

qc_failure_reason.descr: Reason for QC failure, if applicable.

sample_contamination_estimate.descr: Estimated contamination fraction or percentage in the sequenced DNA sample.

related_participant_id.descr: Identifier(s) for related participants in the study, if family structure or kinship is known.

population_representativeness_note.descr: Short note on how the participant fits the intended population diversity or sampling design.

data_access_level.descr: Permitted access level for this record's associated genomic data, such as open, controlled, embargoed, or restricted.

anonymization_status.descr: Degree of de-identification applied to the record, such as fully de-identified, pseudonymized, or identifiable.
